# db-07 — DataBall must choose its store by size and take engine settings

Non-`.ball` opens use in-memory DuckDB below a threshold and a file-backed store above it. `memory_limit`, `threads`, and `temp_directory` come from config. Larger-than-RAM data is a goal; the threshold and temp location are open owner questions.
